title: potentilla canescens subsp. cana
intro: Potentilla canescens subsp. cana, commonly known as Hoary Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents of Hoary Cinquefoil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
